# StressProof — Data Schemas

This directory contains the normative schema definitions for StressProof data interchange files.

## Files

* [case-file.md](file:///Users/maddy/StressProof/docs/schemas/case-file.md): The canonical case file published by the attester and committed on-chain via `evidenceHash`.
* [replay-report.md](file:///Users/maddy/StressProof/docs/schemas/replay-report.md): The replay report generated by the watcher when evaluating a claim and published when challenging.

## Canonical JSON Rules

Every stored or hashed JSON document must comply with:
1. Pure UTF-8 without byte-order marks.
2. Non-ASCII characters escaped using `\uXXXX` (`ensure_ascii=True`).
3. Keys sorted by Unicode code point.
4. Compact separators: `","` between items, `":"` between key and value (no extraneous whitespace).
5. No floating point values (`float` is strictly prohibited).
6. Large integers (amounts, prices, debts) formatted as unsigned decimal strings matching `^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$`.
7. Small bounded integers (percentages, basis points, decimals, counts) formatted as native JSON integers.
